READ-ONLY SEO AUDIT · SPRINGFIELD, VA

Brio Dental Care Springfield — SEO audit

Five verified issues and the next fix for each.

October 1, 2026 · 53 distinct sitemap URLs checked · targeted area pages, GBP and Google evidence

Service links lead to missing pagesBusiness and review markup conflictArea pages repeat most of their bodyMobile lab loading needs diagnosisThe on-site Google rating is out of dateFix order
01

Service links lead to missing pages

The sampled site links to 11 distinct service URLs that return HTTP 404, including five dead destinations repeated across all five area pages.

  • Replace links with verified live, relevant pages; remove links for treatments that are not offered.
  • Use a 301 only where an old URL has a genuine equivalent or retained search/link demand.
02

Business and review markup conflict

The sitewide Dentist schema lists Saturday hours despite a closed GBP and footer, while Google's indexed snapshots flag multiple aggregate ratings on four inspected pages.

  • Publish one GBP-verified Dentist entity and correct the shared hours, map and coordinates.
  • Remove unsuitable Product, Offer and repeated rating blocks from the treatment-page template, retaining accurate Service markup.
03

Area pages repeat most of their body

Five area pages have distinct introductions but six of nine body sections repeat exactly, producing 91.8–93.7% pairwise text similarity.

  • Keep useful area pages, but add verified local travel, access and patient details instead of repeating full service and team sections.
  • Replace the all-areas hub’s Kingstowne-only booking sentence with a neutral Springfield office CTA.
04

Mobile lab loading needs diagnosis

One Google mobile lab run scored 55/100 with an 8.04-second LCP on the homepage’s second-section text, while desktop scored 98/100.

  • Inspect the mobile waterfall, blocking scripts and timing of the second section before changing assets.
  • Optimize confirmed blockers and retest; video or image savings alone do not prove an LCP fix.
05

The on-site Google rating is out of date

The live site displays a 4.6-star rating from 91 reviews, while the exact current Google Business Profile shows 4.7 stars from 115 reviews.

  • Check the Trustindex feed and cache, then refresh the displayed rating from the verified listing.

Fix order

Repair broken care paths and inaccurate markup first, then improve area-page usefulness and measured mobile loading.

  • First: live link targets, Dentist/Product/review schema and exact GBP consistency.
  • Next: area-page differentiation, mobile waterfall fixes and the review-widget sync.

Selected findings only; 53 sitemap URLs plus targeted linked pages were checked. Mobile speed is one lab run, not real-user Core Web Vitals. No site, GBP, analytics or ticket changes were made.
